Subject: Quick recap + next steps on security intake and DDQ

Hi Emily — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the compliance items you flagged:

- SOC 2 Type II: you asked for our latest report + bridge letter. We can share a redacted copy and a bridge letter.
- Vendor DDQ: you mentioned a short vendor security questionnaire (about 40 items). Can you share the questionnaire or confirm you prefer the standard shared DDQ link?
- Portal access: we typically provision a Trust Portal account for the security team to download artifacts and comment on items. I can send an invite to security@healthforge.com.

Action items (suggested):
1) We (Ben + Soojin) will upload a redacted SOC 2 Type II and a bridge letter to the Trust Portal once you confirm the email for access.
2) If you can attach the DDQ in reply, we'll assign Soojin to complete the technical answers and Jordan/Ben to follow up on procurement items.
3) Proposed timeline: portal invite + docs by EOD Monday (2/13); answers to DDQ within 3 business days after portal access.

If that works, reply with the best security contact to grant access to (email + full name) and whether redaction is acceptable for the report.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Executive

Hi Emily / HealthForge security team — thanks for sharing the DDQ. I'll own the questionnaire and will start with the items that typically require evidence (logging, data retention, encryption, access controls). Quick notes for visibility:

- We've pre-populated common answers in the portal to speed review; please flag any items you'd like expanded.
- For GDPR/HIPAA scope: Jordan mentioned you asked about residency; our hosted environment has EU regions available but for HealthForge we flagged US-only as the initial scope. If you need EU residency or dedicated/private deployment options we can surface those with product/solutions.
- If auditors ask for raw logs we can provide scoped extracts under an approved request; we'll coordinate with your team.

I'll upload the initial DDQ response set to the Trust Portal by Monday EOD and ping you here when it's ready. Let me know if there are specific control owners you'd like to speak with — I can schedule short technical calls.

Thanks — Soojin
